verdict.rationale: Mailgun supports event-driven automation via webhooks (real-time event data without polling) and Route Management rules for inbound emails (forward, store, etc.), plus integrations like n8n and GitHub Actions for triggering workflows off email/dev events. However, this is more infrastructure-for-automation than a native 'if this event then that action' rules engine with conditional logic across arbitrary triggers. missing for 10: a unified rules/condition builder spanning arbitrary event types and actions, independent hands-on validation of webhook/route reliability, and richer documentation of complex conditional automation scenarios beyond routing and webhooks.
